chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, raising it, said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: Wealth that withholds you from injustice is better than poverty that carries you to sin.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of wealth over poverty in Shia ethics?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a pragmatic ethical framework where wealth serves as a shield against sin, contrasting it with the temptation of poverty. This reflects the Shia scholarly view that material stability is not an end in itself but a means to preserve moral integrity and facilitate worship. The narration underscores the dynamic relationship between economic conditions and spiritual accountability, prioritizing the prevention of sin over asceticism for its own sake.
